content.pedagogy: Pre-A1: no grammar explanations. Learners listen, look, point and repeat. Show new words with the picture and gestures before reading.
content.grammarFocus: A ready-made chunk to repeat, not to explain: He goes to … / He only takes … / Why …?
beforeReading: Show the picture. Ask the guess question: “Guess: What has Grandpa got?”
duringReading: Read the chapter aloud twice, slowly.
Learners point to the colored words (Word Notes) and repeat them.
afterReading: Learners read the “I can” sentence aloud.
content.lessonPlan: 0–3 picture and guess question. 3–8 listening and reading twice. 8–11 new words with gestures and repetition. 11–15 Quick Challenge and two comprehension questions.
discussionPoints: “True or false: His poems are very difficult.” (False)

differentiation.strugglingLearners: Learners point to the answer in the picture or in the text; they do not need to speak.

checkQuestions: “True or false: His poems are very difficult.” (False)

metadata.title: Teacher’s Guide — Yunus Emre (Pre-A1)
metadata.subtitle: 6 short lessons, about 15 minutes each
metadata.estimatedDuration: 6 short lessons (about 15 minutes per chapter), then 10 minutes for the Master Glossary and the Final Challenge.
metadata.targetAudience: Very young beginners of English: learners in grades 2–4, and older beginners who are starting English.
metadata.targetLearners: Learners who read very short sentences with help from pictures, audio and the teacher.
metadata.purpose: Reading a complete short story in English at Pre-A1 before moving on to the A1 book of the same story.
metadata.approachDesc: CEFR Companion Volume (2020), Overall Reading Comprehension, Pre-A1: learners can recognize familiar words accompanied by pictures, such as a picture book with familiar vocabulary. So: short sentences with one idea each, a picture for every chapter, a few Word Notes and choice questions.

readingFramework.before: The picture and one guess question.
readingFramework.during: Listening, then reading twice, pointing to the colored words.
readingFramework.after: True or false, the “I can” sentence, and two comprehension questions.

metadata.grammarApproach: No grammar teaching at Pre-A1. Each book has ready-made chunks that learners repeat and use without explanation: He goes to … / He only takes … / Why …?
valuesFocus: Love for Allah, people and all living things

sensitiveNotes.title: Faithfulness to the text
notes: Do not add events or sayings that are not in the text.
The (pbuh) after the names of prophets is not read aloud; the teacher says it when the prophet is mentioned.
